name: EXM_EXPENSE_TEMPLATES
description: This table contains sets of expense types grouped for specific purposes by business unit, such as Education, Travel, and Relocation.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an expense report template.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the expense report template.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the expense report template.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the expense type is available for use in expense reports.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the expense type can no longer be used.

columns.name: DFLT_CC_EXP_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Expense type assigned to a credit card transaction if an expense type mapping has not been defined.

columns.name: ENABLE_CC_MAPPING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the lookup codes from the charge file are associated with the company's expense types.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether receipts are required for cash expense lines above a specified amount.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_REQ_LIMIT
columns.description: Amount limit, above which a cash expense requires receipt.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether receipts are required for corporate card expense lines above a specified limit.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_REQ_LIMIT
columns.description: Amount limit, above which a corporate card expense requires receipt.

columns.name: NEGATIVE_RCPT_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether receipt requirement rules are applied to negative expense lines.

columns.name: ALLOW_RCPT_MISSING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether individuals can indicate that receipts are missing when they submit their expense report.

columns.name: DISP_RCPT_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether a receipt missing policy warning is displayed to the user.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Behavior of the expense item Description field, which is defined at the expense type level.

columns.name: LOCATION_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Behavior of the Expense Location field, which is defined at the expense type level.

columns.name: NUM_OF_DAYS_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Behavior of the Number of Days field, which is defined at the expense type level.

columns.name: MERCHANT_BEHAVIOUR_CODE
columns.description: Behavior of the Merchant field, which is defined at the expense type level.
